headline: Chief Prosecutor: Sheikh Hasina should return tomorrow, not in December
summary: The Chief Prosecutor has urged the former Prime Minister to return to Bangladesh immediately rather than waiting until the end of the year.
details: The Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) has called for the immediate return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh.
caption:
Why wait until December? The Chief Prosecutor wants Sheikh Hasina back in Bangladesh tomorrow.

The Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) has called for the immediate return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh.

#Bangladesh #SheikhHasina #ICT #Politics #Justice

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Govt [[launches coordinated flood response]] across worst-hit districts
headline: Govt launches coordinated flood response across worst-hit districts
summary: The Prime Minister's Office has deployed the Army and Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) to manage the crisis in affected areas.
details: The Government of Bangladesh has initiated a coordinated flood response plan to tackle the crisis in the worst-hit districts of the country.
According to the Prime Minister's Office, the plan involves a strategic deployment of resources and personnel to ensure rapid relief and rescue operations.
The Bangladesh Army and Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been deployed to the worst-hit regions to assist in emergency response and maintain order.
The coordinated effort aims to provide immediate assistance to affected populations and mitigate the further impact of the floodwaters.
caption:
The Army and BGB have been deployed to tackle the flood crisis in Bangladesh's worst-hit districts.

The Government of Bangladesh has initiated a coordinated flood response plan to tackle the crisis in the worst-hit districts of the country.

According to the Prime Minister's Office, the plan involves a strategic deployment of resources and personnel to ensure rapid relief and rescue operations.

The Bangladesh Army and Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been deployed to the worst-hit regions to assist in emergency response and maintain order.

The coordinated effort aims to provide immediate assistance to affected populations and mitigate the further impact of the floodwaters.

#Bangladesh #FloodResponse #EmergencyRelief #ArmyBGB #NationalCrisis

Source: Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune
